method: Matched original 227833e adapter and frozen adaptive experimental adapter (subsequently rejected); installed selected qwen3:4b deliberately unloaded before same cold dinner request, then two sequential warm rounds of the same ten texts. Shared current source validator exposes effective behavior separately from raw extraction. No code reloads, heavy checks, other agent model requests or actual Google sends during measured runs. No downloaded model. Sample size is small; no speed guarantee. Earlier competing-reload/build runs are excluded. Ollama allocation is not peak RAM. Final production inference payload is restored to the original verified policy; only options-observation instrumentation remains. No final latency improvement is claimed.
